generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
I wish to state that None of my contracts have been terminated foreclosed on account of my default in KPCL or elsewhere during last ten years
I wish to state that My offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid

I wish to state that I have studied the site conditions labor conditions and read the bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that I have submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the tender document conditions completely
I wish to state that I have submitted the bid having studied understood andaccepted the full implications of Special conditions Payment methodology

If my our tender be accepted I we agree to pay 5% of the contract value plus additional security towards un balanced tender amount towards security deposit for the due fulfillment of the contract at the time of executing agreement in the form of DD BG for the specified Guarantee period of contract

I/We hereby distinctly and expressly declare and acknowledge that before the submission of this tender, I/we have carefully read the instructions and I/We have made examination of contract documents and locations where such work is to be done

I/We distinctly agree that I/We would hereafter make no claim or demand upon the Corporation based upon or arising out of any alleged misunderstanding or misconceptions or mistake on my our part of the said contract agreements stipulations restrictions and conditions

If upon written information to me/us by the CE(FM)RTPS/ SE(CHP)M/EE(CHP)M-1 I/We fail to attend the office on the date there in fixed and if upon intimation being given to me us by the Superintending Engineer(CHP)M of the acceptance of the tender or fail to enter into agreement, then I/We agree to the forfeiture earnest money
Any notice required to be served on me/us shall be sufficiently served on me/us by post (registered or ordinary) or left at my/our address given

If this tender be accepted, I/We agree to abide by and fulfill all the terms and provisions of the said conditions of contract annexed or in default there off forfeit and pay to the corporation the sum of money mentioned in the said condition without prejudice to any other right of the Corporation

I/we fully understand the terms and agreements of the contract to be entered into between me/us and the Corporation and the written agreement shall be foundation of the right of both the parties and the contract shall not be deemed to be complete until an agreement has been signed by me/us and authorized by the proper office authorized to enterinto contract by the Corporation.

The intending bidder should have experience as a prime contractor in Servicing of Primary crusher/ Stacker cum Re-claimer / Wagon Tipplers / Secondary crusher/ Travelling tippers & allied equipments. As a proof, bidder should upload relevant Work order/Work done certificate.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work like Servicing of Primary crusher/ Stacker cum Re-claimer / Wagon Tipplers / Secondary crusher/ Travelling tippers & allied equipments, of value not less than Rs. 72.5 Lakhs in the last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) in any 210 MW & above Thermal Power station.As a proof, bidder should upload work order and related work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL and by the Competent authority in case of other than KPCL (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27).

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved a minimum financial turnover of Rs.290 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last five years, (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certificated copy of the Profit and Loss account or Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27).
